q1: SELECT DISTINCT COURSE.COURSE_ID, COURSE.TITLE, TEACHES.ID FROM COURSE, TEACHES WHERE COURSE.COURSE_ID = TEACHES.COURSE_ID AND TEACHES.YEAR = 2010
q2: SELECT DISTINCT COURSE.COURSE_ID, COURSE.TITLE, TEACHES.ID FROM COURSE, TEACHES WHERE COURSE.COURSE_ID >= TEACHES.COURSE_ID AND TEACHES.YEAR = 2010

counterexample: INSERT INTO COURSE (COURSE_ID, TITLE, DEPT_NAME, CREDITS) VALUES (1000, 'Math', 'Math', 3), (500, 'History', 'History', 4); INSERT INTO TEACHES (ID, COURSE_ID, SEC_ID, YEAR, SEMESTER, INSTRUCTOR) VALUES (1, 1000, 1, 2010, 1, 1);
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 selects all courses taught by instructors in the year 2010, while Q2 selects courses where the course_id is greater than or equal to the course_id taught by instructors in the year 2010.
